findings.what: The frozen baseline records `probe | production | clean | no failed requests`. Re-running probe.cjs today against BOTH pat (new release) and production (OLD release 0096a476) gives 6 identical net::ERR_ABORTED failures — relative-path asset requests under /board/<id>/ (katomia.css, kflow.js, katomia-init.js, katomia-core.js, katomia-localdb.js, katomia-board.css).
findings.conclusion: Production on the PREVIOUS release reproduces it exactly, so this is pre-existing and NOT caused by TXSTATUS-CONSOLIDATE1. What it does show is that the frozen baseline's 'probe clean' line is not reproducible as written — the exact command/URL was never recorded alongside the verdict, so it cannot be established what was actually measured.
findings.lesson: A benchmark entry must record the command that produced it, not just the verdict. Same class of gap as test ids that resolve to nothing.
findings.followup: Worth its own look: whether those aborted relative-path requests are benign (cancelled by a clean-URL redirect — the board does load and sign successfully on both targets) or a real waste on every board load.
